string translate(string text, string source, string target)
    result := ""
    for: i < #text
        match source.find(text[i])
            nat index
                result += target[index]
            none
                result += text[i]
    return result

string lower(string text)
    return translate(text, "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")

string upper(string text)
    return translate(text, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")

bool is_upper(string text)
    return text == upper(text)

bool is_lower(string text)
    return text == lower(text)

bool is_letter(string character)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

bool is_digit(string character)
    return "0123456789".contains(character)

bool all_of(string text, func<bool(string)> predicate)
    for: i < #text
        if not predicate(text[i])
            return false
    return true

nat smaller(nat first, nat second)
    return if first < second then first else second

bool text_less(string first, string second)
    int[] a := first.codepoints()
    int[] b := second.codepoints()
    for: i < smaller(#a, #b)
        if a[i] != b[i]
            return a[i] < b[i]
    return #a < #b

bool contains<T>(T[] items, T item)
    for value := items[]
        if value == item
            return true
    return false

T[] head<T>(T[] items, nat count)
    return items[:<smaller(count, #items)]

T[] sorted_by<T>(T[] items, func<bool(T, T)> before)
    if #items <= 1
        return items
    middle := #items / 2
    left := sorted_by(items[:<middle], before)
    right := sorted_by(items[middle:], before)
    T[] merged := []
    nat i := 0
    nat j := 0
    while i < #left and j < #right
        if before(right[j], left[i])
            merged = merged.append(right[j])
            j += 1
        else
            merged = merged.append(left[i])
            i += 1
    return merged.concat(left[i:]).concat(right[j:])

void increment<K>(map<K, nat> &counts, K key)
    match counts.get(key)
        nat count
            .counts.set(key, count + 1)
        none
            .counts.set(key, 1)

void emit(string[] parts)
    println("{parts.join(" ")}")

string | error word_argument(string text)
    if not (1 <= #text <= 30 and all_of(text, is_letter))
        return error("BAD WORD {text}")
    return lower(text)

nat | error number_argument(string text, nat minimum, nat maximum)
    if not (1 <= #text <= 7 and all_of(text, is_digit))
        return error("BAD NUMBER {text}")
    value := try nat(text)
    if not (minimum <= value <= maximum)
        return error("BAD NUMBER {text}")
    return value

string decimal_text(nat numerator, nat denominator, nat digits)
    scale := 10 ^ digits
    value := (2 * numerator * scale + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    fraction := "{value % scale}"
    return "{value / scale}.{"0" * (digits - #fraction)}{fraction}"

string capitalize_first(string word)
    return upper(word[0]) + word[1:]

string apply_case(string token_text, string word)
    if #token_text >= 2 and is_upper(token_text)
        return upper(word)
    if is_upper(token_text[0])
        return capitalize_first(word)
    return word

class Token(
    nat number,
    string text,
    string word,
    nat end,
    string gap,
    bool sentence_start,
    bool repeat,
)
    bool mixed_case()
        return not is_lower(text[1:]) and not is_upper(text)

    string recased(string replacement)
        result := apply_case(text, replacement)
        if sentence_start and is_lower(result[0])
            return capitalize_first(result)
        return result

Token[] tokenize(string text)
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat position := 0
    nat start := 0
    while start < #text
        if not is_letter(text[start])
            start += 1
            continue
        end := start
        while end < #text and is_letter(text[end])
            end += 1
        gap := text[position:<start]
        token_text := text[start:<end]
        word := lower(token_text)
        first := #tokens == 0
        sentence_start := first or gap.contains(".") or gap.contains("!") or gap.contains("?")
        repeat := (
            not first
            and word == tokens[-1].word
            and gap == " " * #gap
        )
        token := Token(#tokens + 1, token_text, word, end, gap, sentence_start, repeat)
        tokens = tokens.append(token)
        position = end
        start = end
    return tokens

bool is_swap(int[] first, int[] second, nat i, nat j)
    return i >= 2 and j >= 2 and first[i - 1] == second[j - 2] and first[i - 2] == second[j - 1]

class EditMetric(bool keyboard)
    nat gap := if keyboard then 2 else 1
    bool[][] adjacent := array(26, fill = array(26, fill = false))
    local neighbors := [
        "qswz", "ghnv", "dfvx", "cefrsx", "drsw", "cdgrtv", "bfhtvy", "bgjnuy", "jkou",
        "hikmnu", "ijlmo", "kop", "jkn", "bhjm", "iklp", "lo", "aw", "deft",
        "adewxz", "fgry", "hijy", "bcfg", "aeqs", "cdsz", "ghtu", "asx",
    ]
    for: keys := neighbors[letter]
        for key := keys.codepoints()[]
            adjacent[letter][key - 97] = true

    nat substitution(int first, int second)
        if first == second
            return 0
        if not keyboard
            return 1
        return if adjacent[first - 97][second - 97] then 1 else 2

    nat[][] distance_table(string first, string second)
        int[] a := first.codepoints()
        int[] b := second.codepoints()
        nat[][] table := array(#a + 1, fill = array(#b + 1, fill = 0))
        for: i <= #a
            table[i][0] = i * gap
        for: j <= #b
            table[0][j] = j * gap
        for: 1 <= i <= #a
            for: 1 <= j <= #b
                best := smaller(table[i - 1][j], table[i][j - 1]) + gap
                best = smaller(best, table[i - 1][j - 1] + substitution(a[i - 1], b[j - 1]))
                if is_swap(a, b, i, j)
                    best = smaller(best, table[i - 2][j - 2] + 1)
                table[i][j] = best
        return table

    nat distance(string first, string second)
        return distance_table(first, second)[#first][#second]

    nat prefix_distance(string word, string other)
        nat[] row := distance_table(word, other)[#word]
        best := row[0]
        for value := row[]
            best = smaller(best, value)
        return best

    (nat, string[]) operations(string first, string second)
        nat[][] table := distance_table(first, second)
        int[] a := first.codepoints()
        int[] b := second.codepoints()
        string[] found := []
        i := #a
        j := #b
        while i > 0 or j > 0
            diagonal := i >= 1 and j >= 1
            if diagonal and table[i][j] == table[i - 1][j - 1] + substitution(a[i - 1], b[j - 1])
                if a[i - 1] != b[j - 1]
                    found = found.append("sub:{first[i - 1]}>{second[j - 1]}")
                i -= 1
                j -= 1
            elif is_swap(a, b, i, j) and table[i][j] == table[i - 2][j - 2] + 1
                found = found.append("swap:{first[i - 2]}{first[i - 1]}")
                i -= 2
                j -= 2
            elif i >= 1 and table[i][j] == table[i - 1][j] + gap
                found = found.append("del:{first[i - 1]}")
                i -= 1
            else
                found = found.append("ins:{second[j - 1]}")
                j -= 1
        return (table[#a][#b], found[:: -1])

string soundex(string word)
    digits := "01230120022455012623010202"
    int[] codes := word.codepoints()
    code := upper(word[0])
    previous := digits[codes[0] - 97]
    for: 1 <= i < #word
        if word[i] == "h" or word[i] == "w"
            continue
        digit := digits[codes[i] - 97]
        if digit != "0" and digit != previous
            code += digit
        previous = digit
    return (code + "000")[:<4]

bool segmentation_less(string[] first, string[] second)
    if #first != #second
        return #first < #second
    for a := first[], b := second[]
        if a != b
            return text_less(a, b)
    return false

class Candidate(string word, nat distance, nat frequency)

class WordCount(string word, nat count)

class Correction(string word, string replacement, nat count)

bool candidate_before(Candidate first, Candidate second)
    if first.distance != second.distance
        return first.distance < second.distance
    if first.frequency != second.frequency
        return first.frequency > second.frequency
    return text_less(first.word, second.word)

bool count_before(WordCount first, WordCount second)
    if first.count != second.count
        return first.count > second.count
    return text_less(first.word, second.word)

bool word_before(WordCount first, WordCount second)
    return text_less(first.word, second.word)

bool correction_before(Correction first, Correction second)
    if first.count != second.count
        return first.count > second.count
    if first.word != second.word
        return text_less(first.word, second.word)
    return text_less(first.replacement, second.replacement)

WordCount[] word_counts(string[] words, nat[] counts)
    WordCount[] result := []
    for word := words[], count := counts[]
        result = result.append(WordCount(word, count))
    return result

class UndoRecord(
    string name,
    string[] words,
    nat[] frequencies,
    string[] ignored,
    string[] rule_sources,
    string[] rule_targets,
)

class Counters()
    nat checked := 0
    nat unknown := 0
    nat case := 0
    nat capital := 0
    nat repeats := 0
    nat corrected := 0

bool takes_text(string name)
    return contains(["CHECK", "CORRECT", "FIX", "PROFILE", "LEARN"], name)

nat | none argument_count(string name)
    if contains(["RULES", "UNDO", "REPORT", "HISTORY", "STATS"], name)
        return 0
    if contains(["DIST", "PREFIX", "COMPLETE", "LIST", "ADD", "RULE", "SET"], name)
        return 2
    single := [
        "SUGGEST", "SOUNDEX", "SOUNDS", "SPLIT", "WORD", "REMOVE", "IGNORE", "UNIGNORE", "UNRULE",
        "KEYBOARD",
    ]
    if contains(single, name)
        return 1
    return none

class SpellChecker(map<string, nat> dictionary)
    const nat max_word_length := 30
    const nat max_frequency := 1000000
    const nat max_listed := 20
    const nat report_size := 10
    ignored := distinct<string>()
    rules := map<string, string>()
    metric := EditMetric(false)
    nat base_limit := 2
    nat suggestion_count := 5
    UndoRecord[] undo_history := []
    unknown_log := map<string, nat>()
    correction_log := map<(string, string), nat>()
    counters := Counters()

    nat limit()
        return if metric.keyboard then 2 * base_limit else base_limit

    bool is_known(string word)
        return dictionary.has(word) or ignored.has(word)

    WordCount[] frequency_order()
        entries := word_counts(dictionary.keys(), dictionary.values())
        return sorted_by(entries, count_before)

    nat | error require_entry(string word)
        match dictionary.get(word)
            nat frequency
                return frequency
            none
                return error("NOT FOUND {word}")

    Candidate[] candidates(string word)
        nat max_distance := limit()
        Candidate[] found := []
        for other := dictionary.keys()[], frequency := dictionary.values()[]
            difference := (
                if #other > #word then #other - #word else #word - #other
            )
            if other == word or difference * metric.gap > max_distance
                continue
            nat distance := metric.distance(word, other)
            if distance <= max_distance
                found = found.append(Candidate(other, distance, frequency))
        return sorted_by(found, candidate_before)

    string | none .correction(string word)
        if is_known(word)
            return none
        if rules.has(word)
            return rules.get(word)
        Candidate[] found := candidates(word)
        if #found == 0
            return none
        return found[0].word

    void .record_undo(string name)
        record := UndoRecord(
            name,
            dictionary.keys(),
            dictionary.values(),
            ignored.values(),
            rules.keys(),
            rules.values(),
        )
        undo_history = undo_history.append(record)

    void .log_correction(string word, string replacement)
        increment(&correction_log, (word, replacement))
        counters.corrected += 1

    string .unknown_finding(Token token)
        label := "UNKNOWN {token.number} {token.text}"
        match rules.get(token.word)
            string target
                return "{label} RULE {target}"
            none
                Candidate[] found := candidates(token.word)
                if #found == 0
                    return "{label} NONE"
                string[] words := [
                    for candidate := head(found, suggestion_count)[] then candidate.word
                ]
                return [label, "SUGGEST"].concat(words).join(" ")

    void .check(string text)
        tokens := tokenize(text)
        string[] findings := []
        nat unknown := 0
        nat mixed := 0
        nat capital := 0
        nat repeats := 0
        for token := tokens[]
            if not is_known(token.word)
                findings = findings.append(.unknown_finding(token))
                increment(&unknown_log, token.word)
                unknown += 1
            if token.mixed_case()
                findings = findings.append("CASE {token.number} {token.text}")
                mixed += 1
            if token.sentence_start and is_lower(token.text[0])
                findings = findings.append("CAPITAL {token.number} {token.text}")
                capital += 1
            if token.repeat
                findings = findings.append("REPEAT {token.number} {token.text}")
                repeats += 1
        counters.checked += #tokens
        counters.unknown += unknown
        counters.case += mixed
        counters.capital += capital
        counters.repeats += repeats
        emit([
            "CHECK",
            "words={#tokens}",
            "unknown={unknown}",
            "case={mixed}",
            "capital={capital}",
            "repeats={repeats}",
        ])
        for line := findings[]
            emit([line])

    void .correct(string text)
        result := ""
        nat position := 0
        nat changed := 0
        for token := tokenize(text)[]
            match .correction(token.word)
                string replacement
                    result += token.gap + apply_case(token.text, replacement)
                    .log_correction(token.word, replacement)
                    changed += 1
                none
                    result += token.gap + token.text
            position = token.end
        emit(["CORRECT changed={changed}:", result + text[position:]])

    void .fix(string text)
        result := ""
        nat position := 0
        nat removed := 0
        nat replaced := 0
        nat recased := 0
        for token := tokenize(text)[]
            position = token.end
            if token.repeat
                removed += 1
                continue
            match .correction(token.word)
                string replacement
                    result += token.gap + token.recased(replacement)
                    .log_correction(token.word, replacement)
                    replaced += 1
                none
                    fixed := token.recased(token.word)
                    if fixed != token.text
                        recased += 1
                    result += token.gap + fixed
        emit([
            "FIX",
            "removed={removed}",
            "replaced={replaced}",
            "recased={recased}:",
            result + text[position:],
        ])

    void .profile(string text)
        tokens := tokenize(text)
        distinct<string> unique_words
        for token := tokens[]
            .unique_words.add(token.word)
        unknown := #[for token := tokens[] if not is_known(token.word) then token]
        sentences := #[for token := tokens[] if token.sentence_start then token]
        rate := "0.0"
        average := "0.00"
        longest := "-"
        if #tokens > 0
            nat characters := 0
            longest_token := tokens[0]
            for token := tokens[]
                characters += #token.text
                if #token.text > #longest_token.text
                    longest_token = token
            rate = decimal_text(100 * unknown, #tokens, 1)
            average = decimal_text(characters, #tokens, 2)
            longest = longest_token.word
        emit([
            "PROFILE",
            "words={#tokens}",
            "distinct={unique_words.size()}",
            "unknown={unknown}",
            "rate={rate}",
            "avglen={average}",
            "longest={longest}",
            "sentences={sentences}",
        ])

    void .learn(string text)
        .record_undo("LEARN")
        nat updated := 0
        nat added := 0
        nat skipped := 0
        for token := tokenize(text)[]
            if #token.word > max_word_length
                skipped += 1
                continue
            match dictionary.get(token.word)
                nat frequency
                    .dictionary.set(token.word, frequency + 1)
                    updated += 1
                none
                    .dictionary.set(token.word, 1)
                    .ignored.remove(token.word)
                    added += 1
        emit(["LEARN", "updated={updated}", "added={added}", "skipped={skipped}"])

    void | error .suggest(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        if is_known(word)
            emit(["SUGGEST", word, "KNOWN"])
            return
        match rules.get(word)
            string target
                emit(["SUGGEST", word, "RULE", target])
            none
                Candidate[] found := candidates(word)
                listed := [
                    for candidate := head(found, suggestion_count)[]
                    then "{candidate.word}:{candidate.distance}"
                ]
                emit(["SUGGEST", word, "found={#found}"].concat(listed))
        return

    void | error dist(string[] arguments)
        first := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        second := try word_argument(arguments[1])
        distance, operations := metric.operations(first, second)
        emit(["DIST", first, second, "{distance}"].concat(operations))
        return

    void | error soundex_code(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        emit(["SOUNDEX", word, soundex(word)])
        return

    void | error .sounds(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        code := soundex(word)
        string[] matches := [
            for entry := frequency_order()[]
            if entry.word != word and soundex(entry.word) == code
            then entry.word
        ]
        emit(["SOUNDS", word, code, "count={#matches}"].concat(head(matches, report_size)))
        return

    (nat, string[]) segment(string word)
        length := #word
        nat[] ways := array(length + 1, fill = 0)
        string[][] best := array(length + 1, fill = [])
        ways[length] = 1
        for: length > start
            for: start < end <= length
                piece := word[start:<end]
                if not dictionary.has(piece) or ways[end] == 0
                    continue
                string[] candidate := [piece].concat(best[end])
                if ways[start] == 0 or segmentation_less(candidate, best[start])
                    best[start] = candidate
                ways[start] += ways[end]
        return (ways[0], best[0])

    void | error .split(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        ways, best := segment(word)
        if ways == 0
            emit(["SPLIT", word, "ways=0", "->", "NONE"])
        else
            emit(["SPLIT", word, "ways={ways}", "->"].concat(best))
        return

    void | error .prefix(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        count := try number_argument(arguments[1], 1, max_listed)
        WordCount[] matches := [
            for entry := frequency_order()[] if entry.word.starts_with(word) then entry
        ]
        listed := [
            for entry := head(matches, count)[] then "{entry.word}:{entry.count}"
        ]
        emit(["PREFIX", word, "count={#matches}"].concat(listed))
        return

    void | error complete(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        count := try number_argument(arguments[1], 1, max_listed)
        nat threshold := limit() / 2
        Candidate[] matches := []
        for other := dictionary.keys()[], frequency := dictionary.values()[]
            nat distance := metric.prefix_distance(word, other)
            if distance <= threshold
                matches = matches.append(Candidate(other, distance, frequency))
        matches = sorted_by(matches, candidate_before)
        listed := [
            for match_entry := head(matches, count)[]
            then "{match_entry.word}:{match_entry.distance}"
        ]
        emit(["COMPLETE", word, "count={#matches}"].concat(listed))
        return

    void | error list_words(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        count := try number_argument(arguments[1], 1, max_listed)
        entries := word_counts(dictionary.keys(), dictionary.values())
        matches := [
            for entry := entries[] if not text_less(entry.word, word) then entry
        ]
        matches = sorted_by(matches, word_before)
        listed := [
            for entry := head(matches, count)[] then "{entry.word}:{entry.count}"
        ]
        emit(["LIST", word, "count={#matches}"].concat(listed))
        return

    void | error .word_info(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        nat frequency := try require_entry(word)
        nat rank := 0
        for: entry := frequency_order()[i]
            if entry.word == word
                rank = i + 1
        emit([
            "WORD",
            word,
            "freq={frequency}",
            "rank={rank}",
            "soundex={soundex(word)}",
            "neighbors={#candidates(word)}",
        ])
        return

    void | error .add(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        frequency := try number_argument(arguments[1], 1, max_frequency)
        if dictionary.has(word)
            return error("DUPLICATE {word}")
        .record_undo("ADD")
        .dictionary.set(word, frequency)
        .ignored.remove(word)
        emit(["ADD", word, "{frequency}"])
        return

    void | error .remove(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        nat frequency := try require_entry(word)
        .record_undo("REMOVE")
        .dictionary.remove(word)
        emit(["REMOVE", word, "{frequency}"])
        return

    void | error .ignore(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        if dictionary.has(word)
            return error("IN DICTIONARY {word}")
        if ignored.has(word)
            return error("ALREADY IGNORED {word}")
        .record_undo("IGNORE")
        .ignored.add(word)
        emit(["IGNORE", word])
        return

    void | error .unignore(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        if not ignored.has(word)
            return error("NOT IGNORED {word}")
        .record_undo("UNIGNORE")
        .ignored.remove(word)
        emit(["UNIGNORE", word])
        return

    void | error .rule(string[] arguments)
        source := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        target := try word_argument(arguments[1])
        if dictionary.has(source)
            return error("IN DICTIONARY {source}")
        if not dictionary.has(target)
            return error("NOT FOUND {target}")
        .record_undo("RULE")
        string | none previous := rules.get(source)
        .rules.set(source, target)
        match previous
            string replaced
                emit(["RULE", source, target, "REPLACED", replaced])
            none
                emit(["RULE", source, target])
        return

    void | error .unrule(string[] arguments)
        word := try word_argument(arguments[0])
        match rules.get(word)
            string target
                .record_undo("UNRULE")
                .rules.remove(word)
                emit(["UNRULE", word, target])
                return
            none
                return error("NO RULE {word}")

    void show_rules()
        string[] listed := []
        for source := rules.keys()[], target := rules.values()[]
            listed = listed.append("{source}>{target}")
        emit(["RULES", "count={rules.size()}"].concat(listed.sorted()))

    void | error .keyboard_mode(string[] arguments)
        mode := arguments[0]
        if not contains(["ON", "OFF"], mode)
            return error("BAD MODE {mode}")
        metric = EditMetric(mode == "ON")
        emit(["KEYBOARD", mode])
        return

    void | error .set_option(string[] arguments)
        option := arguments[0]
        if not contains(["LIMIT", "SUGGESTIONS"], option)
            return error("BAD OPTION {option}")
        nat maximum := if option == "LIMIT" then 3 else 10
        value := try number_argument(arguments[1], 1, maximum)
        if option == "LIMIT"
            base_limit = value
        else
            suggestion_count = value
        emit(["SET", option, "{value}"])
        return

    void | error .undo()
        if #undo_history == 0
            return error("NOTHING TO UNDO")
        record := undo_history[-1]
        undo_history = undo_history[:<#undo_history - 1]
        dictionary = map<string, nat>()
        for word := record.words[], frequency := record.frequencies[]
            .dictionary.set(word, frequency)
        ignored = distinct<string>()
        for word := record.ignored[]
            .ignored.add(word)
        rules = map<string, string>()
        for source := record.rule_sources[], target := record.rule_targets[]
            .rules.set(source, target)
        emit(["UNDO", record.name])
        return

    void report()
        entries := word_counts(unknown_log.keys(), unknown_log.values())
        entries = sorted_by(entries, count_before)
        listed := [
            for entry := head(entries, report_size)[] then "{entry.word}:{entry.count}"
        ]
        emit(["REPORT", "distinct={#entries}"].concat(listed))

    void history()
        Correction[] entries := []
        for pair := correction_log.keys()[], count := correction_log.values()[]
            word, replacement := pair
            entries = entries.append(Correction(word, replacement, count))
        entries = sorted_by(entries, correction_before)
        listed := [
            for entry := head(entries, report_size)[]
            then "{entry.word}>{entry.replacement}:{entry.count}"
        ]
        emit(["HISTORY", "distinct={#entries}"].concat(listed))

    void .stats()
        WordCount top := frequency_order()[0]
        nat total := 0
        nat characters := 0
        for word := dictionary.keys()[], frequency := dictionary.values()[]
            total += frequency
            characters += #word
        emit([
            "STATS",
            "words={dictionary.size()}",
            "total={total}",
            "avglen={decimal_text(characters, dictionary.size(), 2)}",
            "top={top.word}:{top.count}",
            "ignored={ignored.size()}",
            "rules={rules.size()}",
            "keyboard={if metric.keyboard then "ON" else "OFF"}",
            "limit={limit()}",
            "suggestions={suggestion_count}",
            "undo={#undo_history}",
        ])
        emit([
            "SESSION",
            "checked={counters.checked}",
            "unknown={counters.unknown}",
            "case={counters.case}",
            "capital={counters.capital}",
            "repeats={counters.repeats}",
            "corrected={counters.corrected}",
        ])

    void .run_text(string name, string text)
        if name == "CHECK"
            .check(text)
        elif name == "CORRECT"
            .correct(text)
        elif name == "FIX"
            .fix(text)
        elif name == "PROFILE"
            .profile(text)
        else
            .learn(text)

    void | error .run_command(string name, string[] arguments)
        if name == "SUGGEST"
            try .suggest(arguments)
        elif name == "DIST"
            try dist(arguments)
        elif name == "SOUNDEX"
            try soundex_code(arguments)
        elif name == "SOUNDS"
            try .sounds(arguments)
        elif name == "SPLIT"
            try .split(arguments)
        elif name == "PREFIX"
            try .prefix(arguments)
        elif name == "COMPLETE"
            try complete(arguments)
        elif name == "LIST"
            try list_words(arguments)
        elif name == "WORD"
            try .word_info(arguments)
        elif name == "ADD"
            try .add(arguments)
        elif name == "REMOVE"
            try .remove(arguments)
        elif name == "IGNORE"
            try .ignore(arguments)
        elif name == "UNIGNORE"
            try .unignore(arguments)
        elif name == "RULE"
            try .rule(arguments)
        elif name == "UNRULE"
            try .unrule(arguments)
        elif name == "RULES"
            show_rules()
        elif name == "KEYBOARD"
            try .keyboard_mode(arguments)
        elif name == "SET"
            try .set_option(arguments)
        elif name == "UNDO"
            try .undo()
        elif name == "REPORT"
            report()
        elif name == "HISTORY"
            history()
        else
            .stats()
        return

    void | error .run(string line)
        name := line.split(" ")[0]
        separated := #name < #line
        rest := if separated then line[#name + 1:] else ""
        if takes_text(name)
            if not separated
                return error("BAD ARGUMENTS {name}")
            .run_text(name, rest)
            return
        match argument_count(name)
            nat expected
                string[] arguments := if separated then rest.split(" ") else []
                if #arguments != expected
                    return error("BAD ARGUMENTS {name}")
                try .run_command(name, arguments)
                return
            none
                return error("UNKNOWN COMMAND {name}")

    void .execute(string line)
        match .run(line)
            void
                void
            error problem
                emit(["ERROR", problem.message])
